newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Perilya sees NZ mine move in late 97.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Perilya sees NZ mine move in late 97.

text.p: Perilya Mines NL said on Tuesday a final decision on whether to proceed with development of the Earnscleugh gold project in New Zealand was unlikely to be made before late 1997.
Perilya said it would await the results of a final feasibility study on the project, government consents and completion of negotiations for land access before deciding on the project.
The feasibility study would comprise bulk sampling trial mining and an environmental assessment, and would cost about A$2.5 million, Perilya said.
The alluvial deposit has a mineable resource of 131 million cubic metres, containing 460,000 ounces of fine gold at an average field gold grade of 0.117 grams a cubic metre, the company said.
Perilya said it hopes to mine about 40,000 ounces annually from Earnscleugh over an 11-year mine life.
The project is jointly-owned by Mintago Investments Ltd, wholly-owned by Perilya and March Mining (Central) Ltd.
Sam March, project manager of the Earnscleugh project, is a director of March Mining.
